## How it was checked

- [ ] `swift test` passes; new behavior has a test that failed before the change
- [ ] Anything that overwrites or removes a user's file backs it up first or moves it to the Trash
- [ ] No network calls, no credentials, tokens, cookies or Keychain access
- [ ] Claude's data is written only while that window is closed
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG updated if users will notice the change
